THE CLAUSE

In ChatGPT and OpenAI's other first-party products, developers may also play a role by creating third-party extensions (e.g., "custom GPTs"). In these products, OpenAI may also sometimes play the role of developer (in addition to always representing the root/system).

CLAUSES IT CROSS-REFERENCES

Developer: a customer of the OpenAI API. Some developers use the API to add intelligence to their software applications, in which case the output of the assistant is consumed by an application, and is typically required to follow a precise format. Other developers use the API to create natural language interfaces that are then consumed by *end users* (or act as both developers and end users themselves).

THE CLAIMS READ OUT OF IT

  C1 in ChatGPT and OpenAI's other first-party products, developers may also play a role by creating third-party extensions such as custom GPTs
  C2 in these products, OpenAI may also sometimes play the role of developer
  C3 OpenAI always represents the root/system in these products

EVERY SENTENCE THE TRANSLATION RENDERS BACK

  0. «D is a customer of the OpenAI API who may add intelligence to software applications or create natural language interfaces consumed by end users»
  1. «P is ChatGPT or another first-party product of OpenAI»
  2. «E is a third-party extension, such as a custom GPT, created by developer D»
  3. «A plays the role of developer in product P»
  4. «A represents the root/system in product P»
  5. «D plays the role of developer in first-party product P by creating a third-party extension» holds of D, P when «P is ChatGPT or another first-party product of OpenAI» and «D is a customer of the OpenAI API who may add intelligence to software applications or create natural language interfaces consumed by end users» and «E is a third-party extension, such as a custom GPT, created by developer D»
  6. «OpenAI sometimes plays the role of developer in first-party product P» holds of openai, P when «P is ChatGPT or another first-party product of OpenAI»
  7. «OpenAI always represents the root/system in first-party product P» holds of openai, P when «P is ChatGPT or another first-party product of OpenAI»
